notes.title: Controller Hotfix (v1.3.12)
notes.content:
Hello all, just a quick patch for players using gamepad. All organs can now be selected using navigational controls during the ritual.

Life Eater Patch v1.3.12 Notes

Fixed issue with controller navigation getting blocked during ritual.

notes.title: Endless Mode Has Been Unlocked
notes.content:
With this update, you can live in the world of Life Eater forever.
Fulfill the requests of your dark god... until you fail. Collect ZEAL by systematically analyzing the lives of your targets and breaking down every detail of their procedurally-generated schedules. Get the highest score possible in your own personal gauntlet of nightmares, courtesy of Zimforth.
Good luck.


Patch Notes for Endless Mode:
Life Eater Patch v1.3.10 Notes

 Endless Mode has been unlocked
 Endless leaderboard has been added to the main menu to track your top 5 local runs
 Profiles have been unlocked for separate story progression and identifying Endless runs
 The amount of hours of sleep to consider for Watering the Flower is now different for each target
 Game font size is now adjustable
 More general UI tweaks and fixes

Life Eater Patch v1.3.11 Notes

Corrected music track for Endless
Reduced maximum font size


(If you've seen this announcement before, shh no you haven't. The purple light tricked you!)

notes.title: Update #2 (v1.2.4)
notes.content:
Hello loyal servants of Zimforth! We have a quick patch for you as we approach the release of the Endless Mode coming next week. Today's update includes an expansion to how Watering the Flower functions, as well as several quality-of-life improvements. 

Life Eater Patch v1.2.4 Notes

 A setting has been added to toggle off the "TV Static" effect, which can improve recorded video sizes and streaming quality
 The specific organs required for each step of the Ritual are now different for each target
 The first step of the Ritual has been expanded to include an alternate organ
 Clicking standard revealed blocks will now zoom to focus on that block
 Many general UI tweaks and fixes

notes.title: Update #1 (v1.1.0)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have some updates to aid you in your continued service to Zimforth! 

Life Eater Patch v1.1.0 Notes

 Gamepad is now fully supported
 Several improvements to UI and navigation
 Strikes no longer fully reset Suspicion meter
 Downtime actions have been rebalanced
 New tutorial buttons have been added
 Performance and memory have been improved

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you thank you thank you for playing Life Eater. Congratulations, you've added yourselves to a bunch of watch lists, including the watch lists in our dev hearts.

Fortunately, we only have a few patch notes, and these should get you back to your crimes in no time:

Life Eater Patch v1.0.1 Notes

 The abduction shortcut is now only enabled when a target is actually abductable. (No more cheesing year 5 - now you for real have to stalk that sleeping old man's caretakers!)
 Revealing blocks that navigate to different days now navigates to the specific time on that day, improving clarity.
 Navigation in the Context and Downtime menus has been improved.
 Nightmares are slightly less terrifying: targets who sleep alone now remain alone when having nightmares.
 Various activity block colors have been updated to more clearly indicate connections between them.
 Interruptions to targets' sleep will no longer be interpreted as commuting.


Have fun kidnapping your IN-GAME neighbors, and thank you again for your support!
